correctness.rationale: Finite exact proof reduces all length-2^k factors to all offsets in concatenations of eight occurring adjacent substitution state blocks. Each of the eight state pairs appears in a fixed-point prefix and their set is substitution-closed. The included self-contained C++17 verifier exhaustively enumerates all words and least-rotation classes at each k=4,...,13, checking the claimed distribution. Execution returned VERIFY_OK. Independent definitions of the binary sequence, direct factor sets up to n=64, and brute least rotations up to n=32 cross-check normalization and canonicalization; no infinite claim.

value.rationale: This is not an arbitrary choice of ten parameters: dyadic lengths are the intrinsic block scales of the four-state uniform substitution, and n=16 is the observed onset of a rigid multiplicity spectrum absent at n=8. The complete orbit-occupancy census for ten consecutive substitution scales (rather than only raw complexity) gives exact reproducible benchmarks for the natural cyclic complexity of the classical Rudin–Shapiro sequence; four necklaces retain all rotations while almost all others have only one representative. These observations motivate structural investigation without pretending to prove an infinite formula.
